tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: Which is the correct order of second ionization potential of $\mathrm{C}, \mathrm{N}, \mathrm{O}$ and $\mathrm{F}$ in the following ?

solution.text: The second ionization potential means removal of electron from cation $\mathrm{C}^{+}=1 s^2 2 s^2 2 p^1, \mathrm{~N}^{+}=1 s^2 2 s^2 2 p^2$ $\mathrm{O}^{+}=1 s^2 2 s^2 2 p^3, \mathrm{~F}^{+}=1 s^2 2 s^2 2 p^4$ Therefore $\mathrm{O}>\mathrm{F}>\mathrm{N}>\mathrm{C}$
